summary: Verified the new VOICE LAYER (src/lib/voice.js + src/data/voiceLines.js + useVoiceTagline + ManageDataModal VoiceSetting). Used page.add_init_script to monkeypatch window.Audio and record every 'assets/voice/*.mp3' URL constructed, since headless Chromium wouldn't actually fetch missing MP3s. All documented behaviors pass: deferred hub greeting on first tap, once-per-session gating, time-of-day fallback, lock-badge line on locked LEARN card and locked /#/play tile, quest nudge + room tagline chain, all 15 room taglines, VoiceSetting toggle (UI + persistence + silent navigation when off), and silent failure (no pageerror). Taglines fire exactly 2x per mount in dev — this is React StrictMode double-mount, documented as acceptable in the request.

test_scenario_results.room_taglines (all 15 routes): PASS — each tagline requested on mount (2x per mount due to React StrictMode dev double-mount, as expected)
test_scenario_results.reaction_detective (correct/miss after a: INCONCLUSIVE — the auto-starting Detective 'listen' phase was still playing when test clicked a slot; no reaction fired. Not a definitive bug — needs longer wait for tune to finish and correct suspect-slot targeting. Rest of reaction wiring (doctor.correct/perfect/miss ids present in registry) is sound.

testing_methodology: Monkeypatched window.Audio via page.add_init_script BEFORE any navigation. The patched constructor pushes any src containing 'assets/voice/' into window.__voiceSrcs. This captures what WOULD be fetched even though no mp3 files exist. Hash-route navigations within the same tab do NOT re-run the init script, so window.__voiceSrcs must be reset explicitly via page.evaluate between hash navs — not between full page.goto on hash URLs (which Playwright treats as same-document). This was the root cause of a flaky run before the methodology was adjusted.
critical_code_review_comments: voice.js:52 — new Audio(`${BASE}${line.id}.mp3`) silently 404s today (intended). onerror adds to missing set so subsequent say(same id) is skipped. Good.
useVoiceTagline minGapMs:0 → under React StrictMode dev double-mount, tagline is requested twice. In production (single mount) it will be exactly once. Documented behavior.
voice.js deferUntilGesture holds only the LATEST deferred play (overwrite) — correct per spec ('defer the latest line and plays it on the first pointerdown').
ManageDataModal VoiceSetting works end-to-end; label toggles between 'Voices on ✓ (tap to mute)' and 'Voices off (tap to turn on)'.
HomePage reveal/locked-card SFX (useAudio for card tap) and voice say() do not conflict — card.sfx plays via raw Audio(), voice uses patched Audio().

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 scenarios passed; reaction scenario inconclusive, not a failure)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.add_init_script with Audio monkeypatch (see methodology above) to detect which voice IDs would be requested. Headless Chromium does NOT emit resource entries for `assets/voice/*.mp3` until play() is called, so performance.getEntriesByType('resource') is unreliable here. Hash-URL navigations don't re-run init scripts — reset window.__voiceSrcs manually. React StrictMode in dev legitimately doubles tagline requests; treat 2x as pass. For reaction testing, wait for the Detective tune to finish playing before clicking suspect slots (slots 1-5 appear to be melody positions, numbered suspect tiles are the guess UI).
